policy.fitness: all demonstration pairs reconstructed by either ranked output; not fixed-rank consistency or query success
policy.genotype_identity: validated shared base hash plus two functional alleles; full artifact hash separate lineage
policy.mortality: neutral contemporary genotype preserves age, including death boundary; no elite immortality
policy.selection_cache: none; independently execute two founders and every proposal in each arm
policy.winner: eligible archive maximum absolute demo solve count, canonical genotype then artifact hash tie; archive never parent pool
policy.mate_rule: same-hash draw replaced by lowest canonical-hash distinct contemporary when possible
policy.random_control: uniform two alleles from same bank; independent of parent fitness; same physical call budget
policy.mortality_sharing: same mechanics in crossover/mutation; no individual-mechanism efficacy isolation
policy.report_cache: identical canonical winner may reuse report only, explicitly not independent replicates
policy.extinction: remaining proposal budget executes failed baseline placeholders; no archive-parent fallback, no eligible birth/winner
policy.exact_io_duplicate_audit: zero within/cross-split duplicates before policy freeze
policy.limitations: four proposals per arm, narrow synthetic curriculum and exposed nativeDEV; no efficacy/frontier claim
